claim: A PUSH fill into Layer 2 with the stack pointing at the screen bank runs with interrupts on, so the interrupt entry must switch to its own stack.

evidence.text: PUSH fill used for spans of 16 pixels or more and clear rows, with SP in Layer 2 and interrupts on (an entry may write only its return address at SP); an interrupt in the renderer goes isr_e = JP isr_full, which switches to the game stack and pages back.
evidence.quote: there (alt ROM: JP to the handler): game stack, pages 10 / 11 / 4 / 5 back, CALL 0xC01F

evidence.text: Castle Master: PUSH fill for spans of 16 pixels or more (5.5 T a pixel instead of 11), stack in Layer 2, interrupts on; safe because the interrupt entry switches stacks first. An interrupt sweep of 75,666 injected moments gave equal pictures.
